sources.name: GaneshaSpeaks
sources.text: You will focus on nurturing the positive aspects of your life today, says Ganesha. You might exhaust yourself mentally trying to set things straight. It would be better to brainstorm with someone close to you or approach people whom you have differences with. The nitty-gritty is fine, but do not forget the larger picture, suggests Ganesha.

sources.name: Horoscope.com
sources.text: When tension builds, your sense of security is likely to falter, Taurus. You may have a hard time dealing with other people. You could be tempted to turn to food or alcohol for inner nourishment. Curing emotional needs by indulging this way may temper your ailment for a while, but it isn't the solution to the overall problem. Work out the bugs with the people involved, and don't try to do it on an empty stomach.

sources.name: Astrology.com
sources.text: It will be hard to focus as the Virgo Moon meanders the heavens in a void-of-course state, dearest Taurus—your productivity dips because of distracting peers and drifting thoughts. Colleagues may also seem out of sorts, which will intensify any slumps you are experiencing. If you can take a day off, consider it. If you don't have the freedom to do as you please, take more frequent but smaller breaks to shake away stagnant energy before it has a chance to build up.

sources.name: AstroSage
sources.text: Take proper care about your diet especially migraine patients who should not miss their meal otherwise it could give them undue emotional stress. You will possess a considerable amount of money today, and with it there will be peace of mind. For some- a new arrival in the family brings in moments for celebration and party. Today, you can come back from office and get indulged in some of your favourite hobbies. This will calm you down. If you were feeling cursed since long, this is the day when you will feel blessed.

readings.text: Work will take a backseat today. You have to face a lot of challenges from the professional front. You need to prove people that you are a sincere worker. Failing to do so may create a wrong impression in the mind of your superiors.

Your fast-paced, intense energy of the last couple days reaches a slow-down. You have come to a speed bump, and you are asked to apply the brakes. Don't fight this. Instead, accept the fact that slowing down your speed right now is for the best.

readings.text: Today Ganesha advises you to be extremely careful while taking any financial decision that’s concerns the commodity or stock market. Speculative transaction must be totally avoided.

You may need to reconsider recent financial plans. Your head is full of all kinds of amazingly creative ideas. If you're a writer, journalist, or publisher, this is a great time to be you. But you need to use these gifts in a responsible way. Make sure you're saving your money with a reliable company.

readings.text: Today, things may not happen as you had planned, and the results may not match your expectations, foretells Ganesha. Yet, you should remain composed and try your best to accomplish the tasks. But, not at the cost of your health.

Making yourself truly comfortable in your body takes a lot of work. Have you ever seen people who look really physically fit, but still something makes them look awkward in their skin? There is more to being "in shape" than meets the eye. It's a whole process that starts with what you eat and how you eat it. (Do you eat on the fly? That doesn't help!) Get yourself eating what and how you would like to eat this week; the rest will follow.

lucky.remedy: Stop consuming alcohol and non-veg food to achieve a healthy lifestyle.
